rationale: Changing pseudo_aligner to kallisto triggers Kallisto index construction using the transcript FASTA supplied by the test profile and replaces Salmon with Kallisto specifically in the pseudo-alignment quantification branch. The resulting quantification outputs affect transcript-to-gene mapping, quantification import, both SummarizedExperiment processes, downstream DESeq2 quality control and MultiQC reporting. The existing Salmon index extraction, Salmon-based strandedness inference and STAR-based alignment with Salmon quantification remain unchanged; this prediction is based on static analysis of the supplied source code rather than an actual execution.
